text: ζητεῖ τὸν ἄρτον, ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἄρτος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
objects: an empty cream ceramic plate with a subtle rim, round and child-hand-span wide, resting on the wooden dining table.
artist_notes: Keep continuity with previous frame; slightly tighter crop on table and Dinosaur’s searching glance.
positioning: Dinosaur leans closer to the table, three-quarter rear view from left, glancing around the room and then back at the empty plate.
The plate remains centered on the table, clearly empty, seen in a tighter top-down angle.
